name: io.github.Liohtml/matomo-mcp
title: Matomo Analytics
description: Curated read-only Matomo Analytics tools: traffic, pages, referrers, e-commerce, real-time & more.

environmentVariables.name: MATOMO_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Matomo API token (token_auth) with view access

environmentVariables.name: MATOMO_DEFAULT_SITE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional default site ID so tools don't require an explicit site_id

environmentVariables.name: MATOMO_EXTRA_HEADERS
environmentVariables.description: Extra HTTP headers as comma-separated 'Name:Value' pairs (auth proxies, Zero-Trust)

environmentVariables.name: MATOMO_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Response budget in characters before truncation (default 50000)

environmentVariables.name: MATOMO_INSECURE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to accept self-signed TLS certificates (explicit opt-in)
